case.short_input: Strong frontend resume vs Frontend Intern JD
case.expected: High score; few or no missing skills; few weak bullets

analysis.score_reason: The candidate is a strong match for the Frontend Engineer Intern role, demonstrating proficiency in the core stack (React, TypeScript, Jest) and providing quantifiable impact in both projects and internship experience.

weak_bullet_ids.original: Developed a Next.js portfolio site with 94 Lighthouse performance score.
weak_bullet_ids.problem: Lacks context on the complexity of the site or specific technical challenges overcome.

red_flags: Internship dates (May 2025 - July 2025) are in the future relative to standard hiring cycles, verify if this is a typo or future-dated entry.

rewrites.original: Developed a Next.js portfolio site with 94 Lighthouse performance score.
rewrites.improved: Engineered a high-performance Next.js portfolio site, achieving a 94 Lighthouse performance score through optimized rendering and asset management.
rewrites.why_better: Uses stronger action verbs and clarifies that the score was achieved through specific technical optimization, without inventing metrics.
